meta.title: bInference Agent: your own AI agent on BNB Smart Chain
meta.description: An open-source AI agent that runs on your Mac and works on BNB Smart Chain day and night. It reads, researches, watches and trades, and never moves a coin without your tap.
gate.label: Tap to wake the agent
hero.title:
You tapped

hero.lead: I am your agent. My home is your Mac, and I work on BNB Smart Chain day and night: I read, I research, I watch, I trade. I never move a coin without that tap.
install.title: Take me home.
